description.en: Thin technical drawings on blueprint, dimension lines and an amber signal.
description.tr: Mavi kopya zeminde ince teknik çizimler, ölçü çizgileri ve kehribar sinyal.

colorRules.accent: the signal and the measured highlight: waveform, connecting lines, key bar and its dimension

display.render: outline (stroke only) for big numbers, solid for headlines

chalk.type: SVG feTurbulence displacement + slight opacity noise

drafting.dimension: thin line, filled arrowheads, extension lines with small gap, value in IBM Plex Mono

draw.type: lines draw on along their paths, construction lines first, then outlines, then dimensions

motion.measure: dimension lines extend from both extension lines to the middle, then the value types on
motion.signal: amber signal travels along circuit lines as a short bright dash
motion.camera: precise pans and zooms aligned to the grid, like moving across a drawing sheet
motion.transition: the camera zooms into a detail of the drawing, which becomes the next drawing
